title: Quinoa Bowl with Nutty Peruvian Flair
description: A hearty and nutritious quinoa bowl infused with the flavors of Peru, topped with a crunchy and nutty crunch.

ingredients.name: Yummy Peruvian Roasted Vegetables
ingredients.notes: A mix of sweet potatoes, carrots, and corn

ingredients.name: Nutty Crunch Topping
ingredients.notes: A mix of chopped almonds and pumpkin seeds

instructions: Rinse the quinoa in a fine mesh strainer and cook according to package instructions.
Toss the sweet potatoes, carrots, and corn with olive oil, salt, and pepper on a baking sheet.
Roast in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until tender and lightly browned.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked quinoa, roasted vegetables, diced avocado, and chopped cilantro.
Squeeze the lime juice over the top and toss to combine.
Sprinkle the nutty crunch topping over the top and serve.
